objective: Two disturbances at once: interaction, the order grid and the address, on 1,280 sampled pairs.
status: Closed 2026-11-10 as supported (computed, pre-registered): of 1,280 sampled pairs of disturbances, all 320 in different composites were independent in every order with the address kept; 83% within a composite, 70% on the outer host, 98% mixed; interacting pairs mostly cancel; post hoc, every pair at distance 2 or more independent.
title: Two points at once
